product_one_liner.value: Harmony Healthcare IT’s HealthData Platform helps healthcare organizations securely manage, migrate, and archive patient, financial, and business records.
product_one_liner.notes: The product page describes managing patient, financial, and business records, and the company’s platform announcement identifies healthcare delivery organizations as its audience. Sources: https://www.harmonyhit.com/products/health-data-platform and https://novacapcorp.com/news/harmony-healthcare-it-partners-with-novacap-to-accelerate-innovation-and-growth-in-healthcare-data-management

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page describes standard, enterprise, and SaaS pricing models, so a pricing page exists even though it does not state prices. Source: https://www.harmonyhit.com/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The Magnolia case study names Magnolia Regional Health Center and describes its use of Harmony’s archiving solution. The Parkview case study names Parkview Health and says it selected Harmony’s HealthData Archiver. Sources: https://www.harmonyhit.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Magnolia-Regional-Case-Study.pdf and https://www.harmonyhit.com/resources/health-data-management-parkview-health-aims-to-enhance-efficiency-with-archiving-solutions/ | named_customers.0: The case study identifies Magnolia Regional Health Center and states it selected Harmony for legacy-data management and used its archive solution. Source: https://www.harmonyhit.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Magnolia-Regional-Case-Study.pdf | named_customers.1: The case study names Parkview Health and says it selected Harmony’s HealthData Archiver. Source: https://www.harmonyhit.com/resources/health-data-management-parkview-health-aims-to-enhance-efficiency-with-archiving-solutions/

employee_band.notes: The company’s LinkedIn profile reports 235 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/harmony-healthcare-it

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The listed headquarters address is in South Bend, Indiana. Source: https://www.cience.com/company/harmony-healthcare-it/-7841860060680087284 | hq_country: The company information page identifies its headquarters address in South Bend, Indiana, United States. Source: https://www.cience.com/company/harmony-healthcare-it/-7841860060680087284

founded_year.notes: The company’s history page states it was founded in 2006. Source: https://www.harmonyhit.com/harmony-healthcare-it-marks-20-years-of-healthcare-data-transformation-and-innovation

eng_blog.notes: The technical category index’s shown articles are migration, data-management, and customer-outcome guidance; the reviewed index did not establish two engineer-authored posts about product implementation. Source: https://www.harmonyhit.com/category/technical

public_docs.notes: The public Blue Elm resource hub has multiple product tutorials, including DR Dashboard, DR Auditor, and OpenGate. Source: https://www.harmonyhit.com/blue-elm-resources-types/tutorial

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open job board lists six roles, including data integration, DevOps, sales, and sales-support positions, but no AI, ML, or data-science-titled role. Source: https://ats.rippling.com/harmony-healthcare-it/jobs

model_provider.notes: The reviewed AI-related material mentions ChatGPT only as a general example, while the Trust Center FAQ and privacy policy do not identify a model provider used by the product. No provider was publicly identified in the reviewed sources. Sources: https://www.harmonyhit.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/5-Voices-of-Innovation-%E2%80%93-AI.pdf, https://trust.harmonyhit.com/faq, and https://www.harmonyhit.com/privacy/

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Trust Center compliance list names SOC 2 and HIPAA (as well as other items not requested in the allowed set). Source: https://trust.harmonyhit.com/certifications | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 is named in the Trust Center’s compliance list. Source: https://trust.harmonyhit.com/certifications | compliance_certs.1: HIPAA is named in the Trust Center’s compliance list. Source: https://trust.harmonyhit.com/certifications

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The announcement calls the transaction a significant investment from Novacap, identified as a private-equity firm; this supports describing the round as a private-equity investment. Source: https://novacapcorp.com/news/harmony-healthcare-it-partners-with-novacap-to-accelerate-innovation-and-growth-in-healthcare-data-management | funding_date: The most recent identified investment announcement is dated 28 November 2023, represented as 2023-11. Source: https://novacapcorp.com/news/harmony-healthcare-it-partners-with-novacap-to-accelerate-innovation-and-growth-in-healthcare-data-management | funding_amount_usd: The November 2023 announcement describes a significant Novacap investment but does not disclose an amount; therefore the amount is unknown rather than zero. Source: https://novacapcorp.com/news/harmony-healthcare-it-partners-with-novacap-to-accelerate-innovation-and-growth-in-healthcare-data-management

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent identified investment announcement is dated November 28, 2023, before the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026; no later round was identified. Source: https://novacapcorp.com/news/harmony-healthcare-it-partners-with-novacap-to-accelerate-innovation-and-growth-in-healthcare-data-management

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists six roles but none titled SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive; its director-level business-development titles do not meet the stated title criteria. Source: https://ats.rippling.com/harmony-healthcare-it/jobs

launched_6mo.notes: The company news index reviewed did not show a product or major-feature launch dated in the six-month window, and the dated ClearWay product-launch announcement is from February 25, 2025. The finding is false for the specified window, not an assertion that no product activity occurred at all. Sources: https://www.harmonyhit.com/news/ and https://www.prweb.com/releases/harmony-healthcare-it-launches-clearway-to-revolutionize-clinical-data-abstraction-and-registry-submission-process-302383751.html

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The announcement dated May 12, 2026 says Brian Liddell became CEO effective April 30, 2026, succeeding Tom Liddell, who became Chairman. This is within the 12-month window. Source: https://www.harmonyhit.com/harmony-healthcare-it-announces-ceo-transition
